clippings.speaker: Jordan Peele
clippings.quote: Michael's a man of immense empathy — very soft-spoken, a very sweet person, very loving. … I think that the best horror is created by those who are in touch with their empathetic side. And that's him.
clippings.title: Michael Abels, Composer Of Jordan Peele's 'Us', Balances Terror With Empathy
clippings.context: Peele explaining to NPR's Tim Greiving why Abels makes a great horror composer, around the release of Us.

clippings.speaker: Jordan Peele
clippings.quote: I knew he was capable of creating a chimera effect of music genre … to take what, to me, sounded like jazz and western score and sweeping Chinese epic — and combine it into this new flavor. That's what I wanted to do with 'Get Out' and 'Us.' I wanted a new flavor of film. I wanted a new flavor of thriller.
clippings.title: For Jordan Peele, the 'Nope' score provides the 'spectacle and the spectrum'
clippings.context: Peele recalling what he heard in Abels' concert piece Urban Legends on YouTube before hiring him for Get Out.

clippings.speaker: Jordan Peele
clippings.quote: the piece of the puzzle that I think really surprised me … was how much the warmth, and the sibling love story and the heart of the film needed to translate through his music. That was a very new thing for me.
clippings.title: For Jordan Peele, the 'Nope' score provides the 'spectacle and the spectrum'
clippings.context: Peele on what Abels' score for Nope added beyond horror: the Haywood siblings' bond.

clippings.speaker: Michael Abels
clippings.quote: It's in no way music for a horror or suspense film. … But it really spoke to Jordan, so that made me feel confident that I could really stretch myself creatively and find an open ear in him.
clippings.title: How The 'Us' Composer Used Silence, Children's Voices And Gibberish To Terrify You
clippings.context: Abels, speaking with KPCC's The Frame, on Peele discovering him through his YouTube concert piece Urban Legends.

clippings.speaker: Michael Abels
clippings.quote: From my very first conversation with Jordan before Get Out, he said, “I want silence to be part of the score.” That has become a touchstone for me, not just with Jordan.
clippings.title: "Nope" Composer Michael Abels on Scoring Jordan Peele's Sci-Fi Epic
clippings.context: Abels, in a Motion Picture Association interview about Nope, on Peele's earliest instruction to him.

clippings.speaker: Michael Abels
clippings.quote: Jordan is someone who's not afraid to look outside his immediate network for people who he thinks he can see a possibility in. … And I count myself among those.
clippings.title: How composer went from posting music to YouTube to working with Hollywood director Jordan Peele
clippings.context: Abels in an interview with TODAY's Craig Melvin about going from schoolteacher to Peele's composer.

clippings.speaker: Michael Abels
clippings.quote: So, when I'm coming up with rhythms, I always want them to be ones that make people want to dance a little, and sometimes [Jordan will] say, 'That's not scary enough.' And I have to go back and I'll make it less dancey and more scary.
clippings.title: How Composer Michael Abels Created a Soundtrack of Horror for 'Nope' (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Abels, in an Academy conversation with Nope star Brandon Perea, on his back-and-forth with Peele over rhythms.
